New evidence-based direction recorded as BasinBridge epic bd-01KY5P0R0C44TYYP5PSA8XZP2V. The innovation is explicitly between matching and deformation: sparse matches become midpoint tangent observations, a robust background motion is fitted before residual smoothing, the velocity is exponentiated through a topology/objective group line search, and matching is repeated after every accepted bridge step. Oracle decomposition must localize assimilation, matching, and fine-refinement errors before five-pair tuning. Existing HalfFlow budget2x and matcher parameters stay frozen initially.
